## TODO: SFO traffic stats

Not built yet. Placeholder so the idea isn't lost.

Idea: the planes service (`backend/services/planes/server.py`, port 42901) exposes a `/metrics` endpoint for Prometheus (port 42004, which already scrapes DataViz), and this dashboard charts it:

- arrivals / departures per hour (from the takeoffs and landings the service sees)
- aircraft tracked in the 40 nm area over time
- busiest airline today, most common aircraft types
- data freshness and adsb.fi errors / rate-limit backoffs

Caveat: the service only fetches while someone has `/planes/` open, so counts have gaps when nobody is watching. Decide then whether that's fine or whether a light background poll is worth it.

See `architecture/ideas.md` and `backend/services/planes/README.md`.
